message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data in any of the visible code paths.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code, and no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are implemented anywhere in the shown snippets.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only plots a class distribution bar chart (plot_cls_bar) for visualization purposes but performs no validation of label values against an expected set, no comparison of distributions across splits, and no label-noise detection tool is used.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples anywhere in the visible data preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via torchvision's `pretrained=True` (e.g., `models.resnet18(pretrained=True)`) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to a controlled internal source.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense mechanism is present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, cryptographic signing/hashing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are present in the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No post-inference checks for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds are visible in the code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision classification pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
